name: Ulughbegsaurus
isnote: Wikipedia calls it a carcharodontosaurid; PBDB places it only in Carcharodontosauria.
sum: Carcharodontosaurian from the Late Cretaceous Bissekty and Khodzhakul formations of Uzbekistan.
